messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
agaskia kisan yayi yawa sannan abi haushinma shine mininster n tsaro wai daga zamfara yake yayi shiru padan gwamnati ma shiru kakeji shima dai toh shikenan allah yakawo muku dauki amiin

output.original_text: agaskia kisan yayi yawa sannan abi haushinma shine mininster n tsaro wai daga zamfara yake yayi shiru padan gwamnati ma shiru kakeji shima dai toh shikenan allah yakawo muku dauki amiin
output.joy: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, amma akwai farin ciki da zan ji idan ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya tashi ya yi magana! Da fatan gwamnati ma za ta sa hannu, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen!
output.sadness: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa kuma duk da haka ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya kasa yin magana. Gwamnati ma shiru take, ya kai ga ba da yarda, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen.
output.fear: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa, kuma yana da wahala ganin cewa ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya zauna shiru. Ina jin tsoro da rashin maganin wannan lamari da gwamnati ke shiru, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen.
output.anger: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, kuma ina jin haushi da ministan tsaro daga Zamfara da ya zauna shiru. Gwamnati ma bata da martani, wannan ba za mu yarda da shi ba! Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen.
output.surprise: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa, amma abin mamaki ne ganin ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya zauna shiru. Gwamnati ma takan shiru, hakan yana da ban mamaki! Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen.
output.disgust: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa, kuma abin kyama ne ganin ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya kasance shiru. Gwamnati ma ba ta magana, wannan ba kyawun hali ba ne! Allah ya kawo muku dauki, ameen.
